notice: Generated by `go test ./internal/composition/ -run TestReadyReasonTableIsCurrent` in go/composition-dynamic-controller, with UPDATE_READY_REASONS=1 to rewrite it, from the same registry as docs/ready-reasons.md: one entry per row of that table, in its order. Do not edit by hand. A reason is identified by condition, reason, status and writer. RENAMING OR REMOVING A REASON, OR CHANGING ITS STATUS, IS BREAKING FOR CONSUMERS: a reason a release carried leaves the registry only through its deprecated list, printed below with the release it was removed in, and a test refuses any other removal. The set is closed except the ApiResolved entry whose reason is "(authn's reason)": authn's own refusal reasons are passed through, an open set. verdict is how a parent composition's rollup reads a child carrying the reason, on Ready only ("—" elsewhere). clearance.kind is steady, timer, next pass or indefinite. sinceVersion is the first core-provider release whose source (with its pinned runtime) contains the reason, a lower bound for a reason string another condition used first; "unreleased" until a release ships it. action is what a person does, shown on screen: changing it is a UI change. detailFields are the status fields carrying the reason's detail beyond the condition's own message. Refuse a schemaVersion you do not know.

clearance.detail: the healthy end state

reasons.meaning: stampReady: the health verdict is healthy, over most of the children it names

clearance.detail: the healthy end state, over a minority of the children named

reasons.meaning: stampReady: healthy, but the rollup assessed a minority of the children it names (#297)

clearance.detail: until krateo.io/gracefully-paused is removed; paired with Synced=False/ReconcileGracefullyPaused

reasons.meaning: Observe, and setGracefullyPausedCondition: krateo.io/gracefully-paused is in effect (Synced=False is the liveness half)
reasons.action: To resume, remove the krateo.io/gracefully-paused annotation.

clearance.detail: until the converging child converges; no deadline (core-provider#498 adds one)

reasons.meaning: stampReady: a child is converging; also stamped after Create's install (ConditionTypeCreating)
reasons.action: Wait: it clears when the composition's children are ready. If it lasts, the message says what is still converging.

clearance.detail: until the failing child, or the observation, recovers

reasons.meaning: stampReady: the health verdict is failing; failObserveWithFinding: Observe failed, the message is the error; createFailedOnDerivedRBAC: a first render the chart or the values refuse, or RBAC the API server refuses, the message is the error (#646); any other failure there stays Creating
reasons.action: Fix what the message names: a failing child, values or a chart the render refuses, or a permission the API server refused.

clearance.detail: until the install or uninstall returns; each hook and each wait must finish within 15m0s (COMPOSITION_CONTROLLER_HELM_TIMEOUT), and the message carries the start time

reasons.meaning: recordHelmOperation, before an install or uninstall (#410); the message names the start time and the per-hook bound
reasons.action: Wait: it clears when the install or uninstall returns.

clearance.detail: until an attempt succeeds; retried at the error backoff, with no cap

reasons.meaning: recordInstallFailure, from the 3rd consecutive failed attempt of a first install (the first two are Creating); kept, with what is running in its message, while a retry is in flight (#636); the message names the failed attempts (status.installFailures.count), the automatic retries (status.installRecovery.count) and the last error. A retried interruption is not a failed attempt
reasons.action: Fix the error the message names, often in the composition's values or the chart; the install is retried automatically.

clearance.detail: until the pending operation settles; otherwise rolled back once pending longer than 16m0s (COMPOSITION_CONTROLLER_PENDING_GRACE) (at once when the pod that started it is gone); the message says how long it has been pending

reasons.meaning: Observe: a release is pending within its grace period, so this reconcile stands down
reasons.action: Wait: it clears when the pending helm operation settles, or when it is rolled back automatically after the grace period.

clearance.detail: until a human who has verified the hooks' effects removes krateo.io/hooks-unverified, or the next successful helm install or upgrade after the recovery runs its hooks and removes it

reasons.meaning: stampReady: krateo.io/hooks-unverified is set: a release stuck pending with no deployed revision before it was rolled back to itself, so the interrupted operation's hooks may not have run (#563); outranks the rollup, whose reason the message keeps. A FIRST install of this controller's that was interrupted or failed, and never deployed, is instead installed again with every install hook (#629, #636), so this reason then means it was not: krateo.io/interrupted-install-recovery is set, an interrupted one reached its cap, or the management policy withholds create (it was rolled back to itself or upgraded, and the upgrade's hooks are not the install's); or the policy withholds update, so nothing is written to the release (no annotation in that case); or the release was live once or is not this controller's
reasons.action: An admin verifies that what the chart's hooks do has been done, then removes the krateo.io/hooks-unverified annotation.

clearance.detail: until at least one child can be assessed

reasons.meaning: stampReady: no child could be assessed at all (#165)
reasons.action: Check the composition's children: none of them could be assessed. It clears once one can be.

clearance.detail: until the controller may read its children (an RBAC change)

reasons.meaning: stampReady: no child could be assessed, and at least one read was refused by RBAC (#318)
reasons.action: An admin grants the composition's controller permission to read its children.

clearance.detail: the next Update records the inventory (core-provider#326)

reasons.meaning: stampReady: the managed-children inventory was never recorded
reasons.action: Wait: the next reconcile records the composition's children, and it clears.

clearance.detail: until a human changes krateo.io/management-policy to allow create, or installs the release by other means

reasons.meaning: Observe: the release is not installed and krateo.io/management-policy withholds create, so nothing is installed (#110 D4, #597); the message names the policy value and how to allow create
reasons.action: To install it, change the krateo.io/management-policy annotation to allow create.

clearance.detail: until krateo.io/management-policy allows update, or the definition's chart and the composition's values return to what is installed

reasons.meaning: stampReady: healthy, and krateo.io/management-policy withholds update, so the INSTALLED chart is FROZEN: a changed chart version or values, or drift, is reported and not applied, so the release may not be at the definition's chart version or values (#110 D4/D7, #597); the message names the installed and wanted versions, the drifted children, or why drift could not be assessed. Replaces only Available: a failing rollup keeps its own reason, and its message notes the withheld update
reasons.action: To apply changes, change the krateo.io/management-policy annotation to allow update.

clearance.detail: until a human recovers the release (for example a helm rollback), or krateo.io/management-policy allows update and the next reconcile recovers it

reasons.meaning: Observe: the release is stuck in a helm operation past its grace period (or its controller is gone), and the recovery, a helm rollback, is a write krateo.io/management-policy withholds (it withholds update), so the release is not rolled back (#597); the message names the helm status, how long it has been pending, and what would recover it
reasons.action: An admin recovers the release (for example with a helm rollback), or changes the krateo.io/management-policy annotation to allow update.

clearance.detail: until krateo.io/paused is removed; paired with Synced=False/ReconcilePaused

reasons.meaning: krateo.io/paused is set (Synced=False/ReconcilePaused is the liveness half)
reasons.action: To resume, remove the krateo.io/paused annotation.

clearance.detail: retried with backoff until the write succeeds

reasons.meaning: worker: a Create failed or was incomplete, or writing the resource or its annotations failed (message: the error)
reasons.action: Wait: the write is retried. If it lasts, the message names the error.

clearance.detail: the next observation, after the retry backoff

reasons.meaning: Observe failed and the handler did not wrap its error with ReadyAssessed
reasons.action: Wait: it clears on the next observation. If it lasts, the message names the error.

clearance.detail: until an existence check succeeds (retried every resync; a transient cause clears by itself) or a human, having verified the external state, removes krateo.io/external-create-pending

reasons.meaning: worker: a create whose outcome cannot be determined is not repeated (krateo.io/external-create-pending set, the existence check failed); reconciliation and deletion both wait on it; message: the cause, that it clears by itself once the check answers, and the remediation (unstructured-runtime#93, #107)
reasons.action: Wait: it clears once the existence check answers. If it lasts, an admin verifies the external state and removes the krateo.io/external-create-pending annotation.

clearance.detail: until deletion completes: finalizer-bearing children get 5m0s (COMPOSITION_CONTROLLER_CHILD_TEARDOWN_GRACE), then the release is uninstalled with each hook and wait within 15m0s (COMPOSITION_CONTROLLER_HELM_TIMEOUT)

reasons.meaning: Delete is in progress or failed (message: the error, on failure)
reasons.action: Wait: it clears when the deletion completes.

clearance.detail: until krateo.io/gracefully-paused is removed

reasons.meaning: Observe: krateo.io/gracefully-paused is in effect; nothing is converging this (paired with Ready=True/ReconcileGracefullyPaused)
reasons.action: To resume, remove the krateo.io/gracefully-paused annotation.

clearance.detail: takes effect after the next change to the composition is applied

reasons.meaning: Observe: krateo.io/gracefully-paused is set but not yet in effect; the next applied change still goes through (#381)
reasons.action: Wait: the pause takes effect after the next change to the composition is applied.

clearance.detail: the healthy end state

reasons.meaning: worker: the pass completed

clearance.detail: retried with backoff; persists while the cause does

reasons.meaning: worker: the pass failed (message: the error)
reasons.action: Wait: the pass is retried. If it lasts, fix the error the message names.

clearance.detail: until krateo.io/paused is removed

reasons.meaning: worker: krateo.io/paused is set (paired with Ready=True/ReconcilePaused)
reasons.action: To resume, remove the krateo.io/paused annotation.

clearance.detail: the message names the next attempt when the server gave one

reasons.meaning: worker: the runtime chose not to call the handler this pass, an endpoint's rate limit or its own concurrency limit; Ready is not touched
reasons.action: Wait: the pass is retried; the message names the next attempt when it is known.

clearance.detail: until a human fixes krateo.io/management-policy

reasons.meaning: worker: krateo.io/management-policy does not parse (an unknown verb, or a stray separator), so the runtime acts on nothing, as observe; it wins over every other pass outcome on Synced (the pass's own events and errors still occur); the message names the annotation and the bad token
reasons.action: Fix the krateo.io/management-policy annotation: the message names the value it cannot read.

clearance.detail: until a human fixes krateo.io/deletion-policy

reasons.meaning: worker: krateo.io/deletion-policy is neither delete nor orphan, so the external resource will be KEPT on delete; reported on every pass while set, not only while deleting; the message names the value
reasons.action: Set the krateo.io/deletion-policy annotation to delete or orphan.

clearance.detail: the healthy end state

reasons.meaning: chart-inspector rendered the blueprint

clearance.detail: until the kind is served (it resolves itself once its CRD exists)

reasons.meaning: chart-inspector answered 422: the blueprint references a kind this cluster does not serve
reasons.action: An admin installs the CRD of the kind the chart uses; it clears once the kind is served.

clearance.detail: until the author fixes the values or the schema (#325)

reasons.meaning: chart-inspector answered 400: the values do not satisfy the chart's values.schema.json
reasons.action: Edit the composition's values so they satisfy the chart's values schema, or fix the schema.

clearance.detail: until the author changes the values or the chart (#583)

reasons.meaning: chart-inspector answered 400 TemplateRefused: the chart's own templates refused these values (a fail/required in the chart, or a template error)
reasons.action: Edit the composition's values, or fix the chart, so its templates accept them.

clearance.detail: until the version skew or defect is fixed

reasons.meaning: chart-inspector refused the request with another 4xx: the cdc and chart-inspector disagree about the request
reasons.action: An admin aligns the versions of the composition-dynamic-controller and chart-inspector, or reports the defect.

clearance.detail: retried on the next reconcile; persists while chart-inspector is down

reasons.meaning: chart-inspector itself failed (5xx, transport); not the blueprint's fault
reasons.action: Wait: it is retried. If it lasts, an admin checks that chart-inspector is running.

clearance.detail: the healthy end state

reasons.meaning: every RBAC object derived from the chart was applied

clearance.detail: retried on the next reconcile; persists while the cause does

reasons.meaning: applying the derived RBAC failed (message: the error)
reasons.action: Wait: it is retried. If it lasts, fix the error the message names.

clearance.detail: until the namespace finishes terminating

reasons.meaning: objects for a terminating namespace were skipped (message: which)
reasons.action: Wait: it clears when the namespace finishes terminating.

clearance.detail: follows ChartRenderable: clears once the chart renders

reasons.meaning: RBAC was not applied this reconcile: the chart could not be rendered (see ChartRenderable)
reasons.action: Fix what ChartRenderable reports first: this follows it.

clearance.detail: the healthy end state

reasons.meaning: the apiRef resolved and snowplow confirmed every RESTAction stage succeeded (X-Snowplow-Stage-Outcomes: [])

clearance.detail: until the stages succeed; Forbidden, NotFound, Aborted and NotRun do not heal on a retry, a transient code clears on the next reconcile

reasons.meaning: some RESTAction stages did not succeed (message: each stage and snowplow's code); the resolved data IS projected, the only False with data, and status.unrefreshedFields names the fields left stale
reasons.action: Fix the RESTAction stages the message names; until then, the fields in status.unrefreshedFields show older values.

clearance.detail: until snowplow sends the header

reasons.meaning: snowplow answered but did not say whether every stage succeeded (no readable X-Snowplow-Stage-Outcomes; snowplow older than 1.12.57); the data IS projected
reasons.action: An admin upgrades snowplow to 1.12.57 or later.

clearance.detail: until the RESTAction returns data

reasons.meaning: the apiRef resolved without error but returned no data
reasons.action: Check that the RESTAction returns data for this composition.

clearance.detail: until authn is reachable (installed on the target)

reasons.meaning: authn is unreachable, so no service token; on a remote target usually authn is not installed there
reasons.action: An admin installs authn on the cluster the controller runs in, or makes it reachable.

clearance.detail: retried on the next reconcile; persists while authn fails

reasons.meaning: authn failed on its own account (5xx)
reasons.action: Wait: it is retried. If it lasts, an admin checks authn.

clearance.detail: until the refusal's cause (mapping, audience, credentials) is fixed

reasons.meaning: authn refused the service token and its answer carried no machine-readable cause
reasons.action: An admin fixes the cause of the refusal: the authn mapping, the audience or the credentials.

clearance.detail: until the cause is fixed; a transient one clears on the next reconcile

reasons.meaning: anything that is not an authn problem: snowplow unreachable, a RESTAction that does not resolve, a malformed apiRef
reasons.action: Fix the cause the message names: snowplow unreachable, a RESTAction that does not resolve, or a malformed apiRef.

clearance.detail: until the refusal's cause is fixed

reasons.meaning: authn refused the service token and named why; the reason is authn's own (e.g. NoMapping, AudienceMismatch, MissingBearer): an OPEN set
reasons.action: An admin fixes the cause authn names in the reason, for example a missing mapping.
